method: Built standard file from file:// (no network; any request is refused and counted), viewport 1280×900. Per engine and document: one warm-up run, discarded, then the measured runs, each in a fresh browser context of the same browser. Open: navigation start to the first frame after the editor is ready. Keystroke-to-paint: from the key event's timestamp to the end of the next rendered frame (a message posted from requestAnimationFrame), one key at a time, 21 characters typed at the end of the middle paragraph. Editing operations (Enter, Backspace, word selection, bold, heading 2 and back, footnote, two undos): input-to-paint each, and in Chromium the longest main-thread task (Long Tasks API, 50 ms and over) overlapping it; long tasks outside every operation (the draft written 500 ms after the last edit) are reported as background. Chromium collects garbage before the editing window. Save: File › Save a copy (serialise, read back, blob) to the next paint; the copy is validated. Print preview: the command to the next paint. PDF: Playwright page.pdf in Chromium only. Memory: Chromium JS heap after a forced collection; the browser process tree's peak RSS sampled every 200 ms with ps (shared pages counted more than once). Medians over the runs.
